# Silo

> Silo is a private file sharing app. Files stay private by default; share
> a specific file by an unguessable public link, or directly with one
> person by email — revocable at any time.

## Main pages

- `Home -> /`: Product overview, features, and sign-up.
- `Sign up -> /signup`: Create a free account.
- `Sign in -> /login`: Sign in to an existing account.

## Key facts

- Files are private by default; sharing is opt-in per file.
- Two sharing modes: an unguessable public link, or a direct grant to a
  specific person's email address (revocable).
- Files can be organized into folders.
- No public pricing page exists yet.
